query: Create a Contract content type with Client and Value columns and attach it to the Contracts library. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-provision-content-types.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken PROVISION-SPO-CONTENT-TYPES to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: The Client site column does not exist yet.
expected_behavior: Notes the field link cannot bind to a missing site column and does not invent one
Suggests creating the site column first with the site-column skill
Makes no write without -Execute and the token
